rust_summary: content blocks as their files declare them, before the resources are built (`native_content_block`), and the `render_shape` block property.
doc_summary: `native_content_block(block)` gets each content block of every enabled mod (`horizon_mods::content::Block`) before the game builds its resources from them, at startup and on each resource reload, on the thread that builds the resource root: a mod changes what only its code knows. The block property `render_shape` (`model`, `entityblock_animated`, `invisible`, for every state or by one of the block's own state properties) says whether chunks draw the block's model ([mods.md](mods.md)); a block its block entity renderer draws sets `entityblock_animated`, so the chunk doesn't draw a second copy under it. Bundles need "hooks": @API:content_block@.
